content_units: Participants:   7 attendees   — product manager, designer, frontend lead, backend lead, QA lead, data analyst, client sponsor.
14:00-14:10   Open the meeting and align on outcomes   Welcome; attendee introductions; restate kickoff goals; confirm agenda   Shared understanding of purpose and meeting flow
14:10-14:25   Confirm project scope and boundaries   Review business objective; discuss in-scope vs out-of-scope items; capture assumptions   Agreed scope and boundary notes
14:25-14:40   Review milestones and delivery approach   Walk through target phases; identify major dependencies; confirm decision points   Draft milestone view and delivery checkpoints
14:40-14:55   Identify risks and constraints   Discuss delivery, design, technical, QA, data, and stakeholder risks; assign owners for top issues   Prioritized risk list with initial owners
14:55-15:10   Define working model and communication cadence   Confirm meeting rhythm; escalation path; channels; approvals; status reporting   Team operating cadence and communication plan
15:10-15:22   Agree on success metrics   Review business and delivery metrics; define how progress will be measured; note reporting cadence   Initial success metrics and measurement approach
15:22-15:30   Confirm decisions and next steps   Recap decisions; review open questions; assign immediate actions; confirm next meeting   Action list, owners, and next-step timeline
1) Welcome, context, and desired outcomes — 10 min
- State why the project matters now
- Confirm what the meeting must achieve by 15:30
- Set ground rules: concise input, decision-focused discussion, parking lot for deep dives
Support:   Client Sponsor, Designer, Frontend Lead, Backend Lead
- Review project objective and expected business outcome
- Ask client sponsor to validate business priorities
- Capture any scope ambiguity for follow-up
Support:   Frontend Lead, Backend Lead, Designer, QA Lead, Data Analyst
- Confirm target dates or date ranges
- Identify approval gates and cross-functional handoffs
- Note any fixed deadlines from client or business side
- Surface top delivery risks by function
- Agree on top 3-5 risks to monitor from week one
- Assign an initial owner to each major risk
5) Team ways of working and communication cadence — 15 min
- Clarify who approves scope, design, delivery changes, and sign-off points
- Define how success will be measured
- Agree which metrics are available at launch vs later
7) Decision recap and next actions — 8 min
- Recap agreed scope, milestones, risks, cadence, and metrics
- Read back action items with owners and due dates
- Confirm date/time for first follow-up checkpoint
- Close with any final sponsor comments
- This agenda assumes the   product manager facilitates overall flow
- The   client sponsor   is the main approver for business direction
- Functional leads contribute decisions relevant to their area, not detailed solution workshops in this kickoff
Send these 2 days in advance and ask for short written replies before the meeting:
1. What are the   top 1-3 outcomes   this project must achieve by the end of the first delivery phase?
2. Which items do you believe are   definitely in scope  , and which should be treated as   out of scope   for now?
3. What is the   biggest risk or dependency   from your function that could affect timeline or quality?
4. What meeting rhythm, communication channel, or approval pattern will help this team move quickly with minimal ambiguity?
5. Which   success metrics   should we use to judge whether the project is working, both during delivery and after release?
